component.name: ProbeIconButton
component.script:
sub init() m.border = m.top.findNode("border") m.top.observeField("text", "onText") m.top.observeField("focusedChild", "onFocusChanged") end sub
sub onText() m.top.findNode("lbl").text = m.top.text end sub
sub onFocusChanged() m.border.visible = m.top.hasFocus() plog(m.top.caseName, "btnFC", "id=" + m.top.id + " hasFocus=" + m.top.hasFocus().toStr() + " inChain=" + m.top.isInFocusChain().toStr()) end sub
